questions.prompt: A session uses the danger-full-access preset. A person then switches only the sandbox mode to read-only. What does the current preset show?
options: danger-full-access, because that was the last preset chosen
custom, because read-only with never matches no preset
questions.explanation: The preset is worked out from the two settings. read-only with never is not in the table, so the report is custom.

questions.prompt: Which value does the bash tool read to decide how to confine a command?
options: The last sandbox/mode event, as before presets existed
questions.explanation: The tools keep reading the setting events. A preset only writes those events; its name is for people.

questions.prompt: A person runs /permission workspace-write in a session that already uses it. What is written to the record?
questions.explanation: The switch writes only what differs. The preset and both settings already match, so no event is appended.
